role: Get the administrator to connect the first drive and understand when search begins
subject: Search starts when the first folder finishes
preview_text: Connect a drive to begin background indexing; the whole drive does not need to finish.
body:
Portway is a searchable workspace for files in a connected shared drive. Its search becomes available in stages as the drive is indexed.

Connecting your first drive starts Portway indexing it in the background. The connection begins that process; the entire drive does not need to finish indexing before search becomes available.

Search works as soon as the first folder finishes indexing. From that point, you can begin searching while Portway continues indexing beyond the first folder.

The next step starts that background work. Once the first folder finishes indexing, you can use search without waiting for the whole drive.
